transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well... I guess what finally scared me into making this appointment is that I’ve been having these thoughts lately. Just thinking things like, you know, if I didn’t wake up tomorrow, that might be easier. I want to be clear that I don’t want to hurt myself, but... just having those thoughts pop into my head really unsettled me. So I knew I needed to come in and talk to someone.
Have you been feeling persistently sad, down, or empty lately?

Yeah, I have. It's... well, most mornings lately, I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling. It's just like the color has completely drained out of everything before I even get dressed to head into the store.
Have you been losing interest in, or getting less pleasure from, things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. I still try to do them... I'll set out my paints at home, or I'll think about going to my pottery class. But when I actually sit down to do it, I just stare at the materials. I feel none of the spark I used to feel for any of it.
{"intent":"Determine how long the current depressive symptoms have been present","question":"How long have you been feeling this way?":"}

It's been going on for about six months now. The low, flat feeling just kind of settled in and hasn't left. It's been long enough that the things I usually rely on to feel better—like my art classes and my morning walks—they just don't help anymore. They don't feel restorative at all.
Was there a specific stressful event or major life change that happened before these feelings began?

No, not really. I mean, I've tried to pinpoint something, but nothing stands out. Work at the store has been its usual self, and there haven't been any big shake-ups at home or anything like that. It really just seemed to come out of nowhere for no particular reason.
Before this six-month period, have you ever had another time when you felt similarly depressed for at least two weeks?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had days where I felt a bit down or tired, like anyone else, but nothing like this. This is the first time I've felt this low for this long.
Have you had any thoughts about how you might harm yourself or made any plans to do so?

No, I haven't made any plans or anything like that. I really don't want to hurt myself. But... well, what finally scared me into making this appointment is that I've been having these thoughts lately. Just things like, "If I didn't wake up tomorrow, that might be easier." It's just a passing thought, but it frightened me enough to come in.
